Package hadur2.core.model

Class BotEvent.BulletMissed

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.model.BotEvent.BulletMissed
All Implemented Interfaces:
BotEvent
Enclosing interface:
BotEvent
public static final class BotEvent.BulletMissed extends Object implements BotEvent
One of our bullets left the field; bulletHeading as for BotEvent.BulletHit. It counts as a miss in our rolling hit rate and removes the bullet from the shadows it cast (MOVE-1).
